results.name: Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current
results.title: Parcel Boundaries of Indiana Current
results.description: This data layer is an Esri file geodatabase polygon feature class that contains parcel boundaries maintained by county agencies in Indiana. It was released by the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO) on February 1, 2022. The IGIO compiled the data as part of the Indiana Data Harvest program between the Indiana Geographic Information Council (IGIC) and all Indiana counties to provide the most accurate framework data for the citizens of Indiana. These layers include address points, street centerlines, land parcels, and governmental boundaries.
results.snippet:
This dataset was developed to provide accurate parcel boundaries for Indiana, as part of Indiana's annual GIS Data harvest Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI) of the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO).

If attempting to download this data in shapefile or file geodatabase format on indianamap.org, please note that this dataset is too large to fit in a shapefile and generating a geodatabase does not perform well in the ArcGIS Hub interface. To download a pre-zipped file geodatabase, please go to https://countydataharvest.in.gov/statewide/2022/DataHarvest_2022_SingleFGDB_20230125.zip.
results.accessInformation: This data set was created as part of the Indiana Geographic Information Office's GIS Data Harvest Program. The source data used to create this dataset was provided by Indiana counties.
results.licenseInfo: CREDIT - It is requested, but not required, that the Indiana GIS Data Harvest Program be cited in any products generated from this data set. If citing, the following source citation language should be included: [Parcel Boundaries of Indiana 2021: Parcel Boundaries Maintained by County Agencies in Indiana, (Indiana Geographic Information Office, File Geodatabase, Polygon Feature Class), 20220201].
results.source: Megan R.L. Compton, Indiana Office of Technology, Indiana Geographic Information Officer

results.title: Carroll County VA Parcels
results.description: Attribution for these Virginia parcels is limited to locality identification and parcel id. Tax parcel boundaries have not been edge-matched across municipal boundaries. The boundaries are intended for cartographic use and spatial analysis only, and not for use as legal descriptions or property surveys. Not all localities within the Commonwealth of Virginia have a digital record for parcel geography.
results.snippet: Parcel boundaries represent legal descriptions of property ownership for tax payers, as recorded in various public documents in the Virginia local jurisdiction.

results.licenseInfo: The Virginia Base Data layers are intended for cartographic use and spatial analysis only, and not for use as a legal description. results.description: This map shows the locations of participating tree farms in the Maryland Tree Farm Program. This document was created for the Maryland Department of Natural Resources, Forest Service. The participating tree farms are classified as CONTIGUOUS or NOT CONTIGUOUS. Participating tree farms were determined by their status as either being: 1.) Pioneer; or 2.) Certified. All decertified tree farms have been omitted and only currently active tree farms have been included.
results.snippet: This map shows the locations of participating tree farms within Carroll County
results.licenseInfo: Access to the data is limited to Maryland Department of Natural Resources employees and to a select group of outside contractors and consultants which is determined on a case by case basis.
